title: Modelling mouse embryogenesis from chemically induced totipotent stem cells
title_zh: 從化學誘導的多能幹細胞模擬小鼠胚胎發育
abstract: The ability to faithfully initiate embryogenesis from a single, induced non-germline cell type, akin to the totipotent blastomeres, remains a considerable challenge in developmental and synthetic biology1–14. Here we established conditions that enable the continuous ex utero development of mouse embryo models (EMs), starting solely from the chemically induced totipotent-like stem cells (ciTotiSCs)15 and spanning the pre-implantation morula, blastocysts and post-gastrulation stages with both embryonic and extraembryonic compartments. These ciTotiSCs self-organized into blastocyst-like structures that closely resembled natural blastocysts in both morphology and lineage segregation. The resulting ciTotiSC-derived EMs (ciToti-EMs) successfully progressed through key developmental milestones, including gastrulation, embryonic axis formation, haematopoiesis and early organogenesis, closely resembling embryonic day 8.5 (E8.5) natural embryos (NEs). Furthermore, extended culture led to the development of functional cardiac tissues in ciToti-EMs, highly comparable to those of E10.5 NEs. These findings demonstrate an extraordinary ability of a single induced cell type, ciTotiSCs, to autonomously recapitulate the complete spectrum of early mouse embryogenesis. Our ciToti-EM system provides a powerful model for investigating mammalian embryonic development and opens new avenues for creating multicellular organisms from non-germline cells. A mouse embryo model derived from chemically induced totipotent-like stem cells progresses through key developmental milestones, including gastrulation, embryonic axis formation, haematopoiesis and early organogenesis.
abstract_zh: 能夠從一個單一的、經化學誘導的非生殖系細胞類型（類似於多能早期胚胎細胞）可靠啟動胚胎發育，仍然是發展生物學和合成生物學領域的一項重大挑戰。在此，我們建立了條件，使得僅從化學誘導的多能幹細胞（ciTotiSCs）出發，可持續體外發展小鼠胚胎模型（EMs），涵蓋胚前著床期、囊胚以及胚層形成後階段，並包含胚外和胚胎兩個腔室。這些 ciTotiSCs 自組織形成的囊胚狀結構在形態和細胞層分化方面與自然囊胚極為相似。所得的 ciTotiSC 來源胚胎模型（ciToti-EMs）成功通過了關鍵發育里程碑，包括胚層形成、胚軸形成、血液形成和早期器官發育，與自然胚胎胚齡 8.5 天（E8.5）胚胎（NEs）極為相似。此外，長期培養導致 ciToti-EMs 發展出功能性心臟組織，與 E10.5 自然胚胎的心臟組織高度相關。這些發現展示了單一經化學誘導的細胞類型 ciTotiSCs 能夠自主重現小鼠早期胚胎發育的完整光譜。我們的 ciToti-EM 系統為研究哺乳動物胚胎發育提供了有力的模型，並開啟了從非生殖系細胞創造多細胞生物的新途徑。一個來源於化學誘導多能幹細胞的小鼠胚胎模型進展至胚層形成、胚軸形成、血液形成和早期器官發育等關鍵發育里程碑。
